text.en:
The barangays of Sinit-an, Guadalupe, Hernandez, Bungliw, Janipon, Quezon, New San Isidro,
Cantaguic, Ranera, Tomongbong, Rosalim, Aurora, Canyake, Sapinit, Bulao, Buenavista, Himay, Aurora,
Calundan, Lincoro, Lapaz, Erenas, Mobo-ob, Cag-toto-og, Matulad, Libertad, Gayondato and Pohagan, all in
the Municipality of Gandara, province of Samar, are hereby separated from said municipality and constituted
into a distinct and independent municipality in the same province to be known as the Municipality of San
Jorge. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in Barangay San Jorge.

The Municipality of San Jorge shall become existent upon the ratification by a majority of the
votes cast in a plebiscite to be conducted in the areas affected within a period of sixty days after the approval
of this Act, after which the President (Prime Minister) shall appoint the Mayor and other officials of the new
Municipality.
The Commission on Elections shall conduct and supervise the plebiscite. The expenses for such plebiscite
shall be paid out of appropriations provided under the General Appropriations Act for the Commission on

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: December 6, 1978
